facts.fact: Agence Ecofin, citing TeleGeography's Submarine Cable Map, says two systems land at Moanda, DRC's cable landing: 2Africa (commercial service in DRC with 200 Gbps activated by Airtel on 2025-12-18) and WACS (in service since 2012, serving DRC); both at the same landing point, so two routes, not independent.

systems.platform: submarine cable, 14,530 km, lands at Moanda
terrestrial fibre, proposed, no timetable or financing
